original_value: It is challenging to directly apply text classification models without much feature engineering on domain-specific use cases, and expect the state of art performance. Much more so when the number of classes is large. Convolutional Neural Network (CNN or Con-vNet) has attracted much in text mining due to its effectiveness in automatic feature extraction from text. In this paper, we compare traditional and deep learning approaches for automatic categorization of IT tickets in a real-world production ticketing system. Experimental results demonstrate the good potential of CNN models in our task.

result.paraphrase: Applying text classification models directly without substantial feature engineering on domain-specific use cases makes it difficult to expect state-of-the-art performance, especially as the number of classes grows. Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs or ConvNets) have drawn considerable interest in text mining because they effectively extract features automatically from text. In this paper, we evaluate traditional and deep learning methods for automatically categorizing IT tickets in a real production ticketing system. Experimental results show that CNN models have strong potential for our task.
